fusions.name: Curled Roll
fusions.desc: Rolls into a spinning ball, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Tuck and Jab
fusions.desc: Jabs for 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises +5% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +25%).

fusions.name: Seams Closed
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.

fusions.name: Overlap
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
